issue: PMAT-588 (forjar#588, paiml/infra#775) — quorum.yml, the one self-hosted workflow still caching cargo on the SHARED CARGO_HOME, gets the job-private CARGO_HOME its four siblings have, and a per-job lint plus a lint-driven falsification test keep every self-hosted cache job that way. On intel every runner shares one home; rust-cache post steps empty the shared ~/.cargo/bin and registry/src. Measured 2026-09-21 06:19:02Z: this repo quorum.yml post step on intel-clean-room-15 left ~/.cargo/bin with 0 regular files and 15 rustup symlinks, killing a concurrent rmedia job mid-run.

quorum.judges_note: judges=3 counts the three lanes asked per round, across four rounds; not three independent tiers. Both lane errors came from the lowest tier reasoning about text it was not shown, and both were refuted by running the command, not by argument.
quorum.kill_rule: nothing was dismissed. Every lane finding was either fixed (R1-R4) or refuted by running the thing it described (two lane errors, recorded in the lanes file).
refuted_claims: R1: the lint exonerated every job in a file once any job set a private CARGO_HOME. Now per job.
R2: a hosted job cache step was flagged because a self-hosted job shared its file. runs-on is read per job.
R3: the Rust copy of the rule read a comment containing CARGO_HOME: as a declaration. The second parser is gone; the lint strips comments and has a comment-only fixture.
R4: the falsification test only asserted the patched tree; the restored-quorum.yml failure was a manual demonstration. The negative control is now in the test.

falsification.test: the_lint_can_still_reject, a_self_hosted_job_caching_cargo_must_own_its_cargo_home, quorum_without_its_private_cargo_home_is_refused_by_name — all written by this branch; the third is a negative control on a temporary copy of the real workflows
falsification.observed_failure: quorum.yml restored to origin/main: a_self_hosted_job_caching_cargo_must_own_its_cargo_home FAILED (1 passed; 1 failed) with the lint ERROR at quorum.yml:55 (job receipt). Lint mutated to always print OK: quorum_without_its_private_cargo_home_is_refused_by_name and the_lint_can_still_reject FAILED (1 passed; 2 failed). Both restored byte-identical: 3 passed.

crux.verdict: No crux row is owed: CI configuration and a lint, no shipped behaviour and no CHANGELOG bullet. Recorded because the design question — who may mutate a cache other jobs read — is real.
systems: Nix: builds run sandboxed with a private HOME and read inputs from an immutable content-addressed store; no consumer can delete another build inputs mid-run [X]
Bazel: each action runs in its own sandboxed execroot and the output base is per workspace, so one action cannot remove files a concurrent action is reading [X]
GitHub-hosted runners: one ephemeral VM per job, the design rust-cache assumes; the defect here is running that design on a persistent runner whose home is shared by sixteen concurrent services [X]

agy_teamwork.mode: three sandboxed agy lanes per round, four rounds, JSON-schema-constrained, diff and ticket pasted inline; per-round table in .quorum/evidence/PMAT-588-lanes.md
agy_teamwork.verdict: pro-high found the design defect (two parsers of one rule disagreeing), pro-low found the gap between a criterion and its test, flash-low produced both false alarms; no tier was reliable alone.
